classifications.legacy-node-http: Existing Web/local/paired HTTP adapters importing the current Node SQL authority; not migrated by WUL-576.
classifications.legacy-node-service: Existing Node services/owners with direct authority or handle dependencies; see authority-census and mutation CSV for ownership and guarantees.
classifications.sqlite-infrastructure: Existing schema/open/repair/maintenance primitives. Not an alternative clinical writer or permission to run maintenance.
classifications.reference-data: Reference catalog SQL, distinct from clinical patient command dispatch.
classifications.paired-scale-read: ADR0153: current authority, membership and selection reads for scale preparation. No clinical writer or key access; persistence delegates to the ordinary entry operation.
classifications.runtime-entry: Declared runtime/maintenance entry or its local dependencies, outside the Web/lib source roots.
classifications.synthetic-support: Existing synthetic-support source; inclusion is conservative and does not authorize real data access.
classifications.territorial-pack-host: ADR0158: named host territorial configuration owner and local supervisor maintenance admission; no agent operation or generic settings authority.
classifications.host-settings-revocation: ADR0076: authenticated host settings persistence and monotonic AI revocation in the same transaction; no clinical writer or provider admission.
classifications.first-ambulatory-bootstrap: ADR0167: named first-ambulatory composition uses the outer IMMEDIATE transaction for current Web/paired authority, archive generation, zero-site gate and exact readback; mutation and audit delegate only to the existing createAmbulatory core within that transaction. No new writer, schema or general administrative authority.
classifications.therapy-status-command: ADR0168: named Web physician status command composes the common therapy Tx core, required audit and terminal receipt under one IMMEDIATE; read/close do not grant chat or generic clinical write authority.
classifications.ambulatory-destructive-command: ADR0169: named clear-test/delete host composition rechecks original paired device and fresh same-admin WebP3, generation and frozen plan under one IMMEDIATE with common Tx core, mandatory audit and terminal receipt; read/close do not require a surviving scope and never grant generic paired administration.

semantics.edge: Exact source path, resolved target, capability, import form, imported symbols and occurrence count. Value imports are conservatively treated as runtime dependencies; explicit type-only imports are not authority.
semantics.barrels: Re-exports, aliases, namespace/default/CommonJS bindings and direct-return handle factories propagate authority. DTO-returning application services and ordinary Drizzle operators do not.
semantics.opaque: Each unsupported dynamic/code/native loader is admitted only by expression, whole-source SHA-256, count and reason. Not isolation against hostile JavaScript.
semantics.scope: Runtime source roots plus declared script entries and their statically resolved local dependencies, including test-named helpers when reached by runtime. Generated/vendor/dependency directories and standalone test sources are not source roots.

rust.classification: No direct SQL dependency in either current first-party Rust experiment; HTTP/ENC client code is not DB authority.
rust.limit: This guard does not parse Rust, Cargo feature graphs, macros or upstream GPUI. Existing Rust test/manifest selection guards remain separate.

swift.classification: Preserved experimental local SQLite core, not selected by the production Apple workspace factory, which uses the paired host.
swift.limit: Classification only: no new Swift parser, FFI audit or vendor scan. Existing Swift store/lifecycle tests and target/test inventory retain their own guarantees.
